title: A Day Hike on Kilimanjaro: Feel the Mountain Without the Summit
excerpt: No time or desire to climb to the summit? A day hike on Kilimanjaro lets you walk through the rainforest and feel the mountain.
body:
Not everyone wants to spend a week climbing to 5,895 m. A day hike on Kilimanjaro is a lovely way to experience the mountain anyway.

## Where you walk

Most day hikes start at Marangu Gate and follow the trail through the rainforest to Mandara Hut (about 2,700 m). Some continue to the Maundi Crater for views, if the weather is clear.

## What you see

Tall trees, moss, ferns and flowers. Blue monkeys and black-and-white colobus monkeys are common. With luck, views of the plains below.

## How long

The walk up and down takes about five to seven hours, plus transfer from Moshi or Arusha. You walk with a licensed guide and pay a day park fee.

## Who it suits

- Travellers combining a safari with one active day.
- Families with children too young for the summit.
- Anyone who wants to feel the mountain without the altitude.

## Combine it

Add a visit to a Chagga village, a [coffee tour and waterfall at Materuni](/blog/materuni-waterfall-coffee-tour/), or a swim at [Chemka hot springs](/blog/chemka-hot-springs/).

[Add a day hike to your trip](/travel-proposal/).
